question: What average pore diameter did the Cu2O-Ag@ACR/LF-3D monolith have?
expect: not reported: the paper states pore-size distributions were not reliable enough and are not reported
rendered:
Neither document directly states the average pore diameter of the Cu2O-Ag@ACR/LF-3D monolith. However, the BET analysis (p. 8) yields calculated surface-area values of 5.65, 4.21, and 8.03 m^2 g^−1 for LF-3D, ACR/LF-3D, and Cu2O–Ag@ACR/LF-3D, respectively. However, these values are not directly related to pore diameter.

However, in the N2 adsorption–desorption isotherms (p. 8), we can see that the Cu2O–Ag@ACR/LF-3D monolith has a larger surface area than LF-3D and ACR/LF-3D. Unfortunately, without more information, we cannot determine the average pore diameter of the Cu2O-Ag@ACR/LF-3D monolith.
